item.title: As private equity reshapes RIAs, advisors look for alternatives
item.description: Private equity-backed M&A activity has steadily risen. Owners may do great in a sale, but what about advisors lower in the organization?

item.title: How a fat thumb and pizza led to a first responder niche
item.description: Financial advisor Drew Boyer turned an accidental acceptance from a fire chief into a successful niche serving firefighters and police officers.

item.title: As ultrarich sweat, advisors tackle 'ripple effects' of proposed billionaire tax
item.description: Even though advisors doubt it will pass, California's proposed billionaire tax is already reigniting residency and wealth planning conversations.

item.title: Huntington Bank gives Ameriprise institutional unit $28B boost
item.description: The 260 advisors in Huntington's wealth unit will now turn to Ameriprise for brokerage, advisory and insurance services previously provided internally.

item.title: Key OBBBA tax breaks for businesses this filing season
item.description: The tax-filing season for individuals just opened recently, but businesses already got a head start on various tax incentives in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

item.title: Private markets face a tense moment with retail push on the line
item.description: Virtually every major firm on Wall Street has joined the push into private markets, with many trying to get in early on the biggest "next big thing" to hit financial services since the exchange-traded fund.

item.title: Nearly 3 in 4 advisors say their firms invest in career development
item.description: Nearly two-thirds of advisors surveyed this month said that internal training programs or workshops were offered by their firms.

item.title: How delegating to key staff helped land a $20M client
item.description: The industry often struggles to help prospective professionals find their place, a challenge experts say is a crucial competitive priority for the future.

item.title: Health care inflation on track to consume Social Security in retirement
item.description: Medical inflation is projected to climb at double the rate of Social Security cost-of-living adjustments, leaving a growing number of retirees with a shrinking share of their benefits.

item.title: How can RIAs replenish the pipeline for new advisor talent?
item.description: Over a third of all advisors plan to retire in the next few years, leaving an industry gap tens of thousands short of anticipated demand. How can firms keep up?
